notes.title: Important Notice: Discontinuation of Sales for Certain Titles
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of our works.
We regret to inform you that the following titles will no longer be available for purchase on Steam after July 31, 2025:

[h1][b]Affected Titles  [/b][/h1]

-Maken-shi Sara
-Meria and The Island of Orcs
-Mireille and Amrita, the Forest of Illusions


[h1][b]Sales End Date[/b][/h1]

July 31, 2025Customers who purchase these titles before the sales end date will be able to continue playing them afterward. 
We will also continue to provide support, including bug fixes, as usual.
We sincerely appreciate your support for these titles over the years. 
Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to your continued support of our future works.

[h1][b]Contact[/b][/h1]
For any questions, please reach out to [info@wasabi.sub.jp].
